login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to your FurOfTheWeak workspace
login.twoFactorSubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Start building tracked links and see who clicks, from where
register.passwordHint: 10+ characters, with upper & lowercase letters and a digit

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: We'll email you a link to reset it
forgotPassword.checkEmailBody: If that email is registered, a password reset link is on its way.

resetPassword.invalidLinkBody: This password reset link is missing its token. Please request a new one.
resetPassword.successBody: Your password has been changed. All existing sessions were signed out for your security.

verifyEmail.title: Email verification
verifyEmail.missingToken: This verification link is missing its token.
verifyEmail.invalidOrExpired: This link is invalid or has expired.

consentGate.linkUnavailableBody: It may have expired, been disabled, or never existed.
consentGate.consentBody: This link may process some technical information about your visit (such as approximate location, device, and browser) for analytics purposes. Location data is approximate, derived from your IP address, and never pinpoints an exact address.

linkNotFound.title: This link isn't available
linkNotFound.reasonDisabled: This link has been disabled by its owner.
linkNotFound.reasonCampaignPaused: The project this link belongs to is paused.
linkNotFound.reasonCampaignArchived: The project this link belongs to is archived.
linkNotFound.reasonGeneric: It may have expired, been disabled, or never existed.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or may have moved.

dashboard.subtitle: A summary across all your projects: who clicked, from where, and what happened today.

campaigns.title: Projects
campaigns.subtitle: Split your links into projects by client/effort — pause a project and every link inside it stops too.
campaigns.emptyDescription: Create your first project to keep links for one client, study, or effort together — e.g. "Client A — Product Launch".
campaigns.name: Name
campaigns.nameHint: You'll see this name in the project picker when creating links, and can use it when reporting back to the client.
campaigns.descriptionPlaceholder: What's this project for, and for whom?

campaignDetail.noLinksYet: No links in this project yet
campaignDetail.deleteConfirmBody: "{{name}}" will be deleted. Its {{count}} link(s) won't be deleted — they'll just become project-less and keep working normally, visit history included.
campaignDetail.name: Name
campaignDetail.statusActiveHint: Links in this project work normally.
campaignDetail.statusHint: Links in this project work or stop based on the status you pick — see below.
campaignDetail.pauseWarning: Saving this will make all {{count}} link(s) in this project temporarily unclickable. You can set it back to "Active" anytime to resume them.
campaignDetail.archiveWarning: Saving this will make all {{count}} link(s) in this project unclickable until you reactivate it. Archived projects also can't receive new links.
campaignDetail.pauseNotice: This project is paused — none of its {{count}} link(s) are currently clickable. Set it back to "Active" to resume them.
campaignDetail.archiveNotice: This project is archived — none of its {{count}} link(s) are currently clickable, and new links can't be added to it.

links.title: Links
links.subtitle: Every tracking link you've created — click one to see exactly who clicked it, when, from where, and on what device.
links.searchPlaceholder: Search by alias, description, or destination…
links.emptyDescription: Create a tracking link to start collecting analytics.
links.deleteConfirmBody: /{{code}} and its visit history will be permanently deleted. This can't be undone.
links.showVisitorsHint: Click this row to open the visitor list
links.noVisitsYet: No visits for this link yet
links.consentNotGiven: No consent given — only an anonymous click was counted, no details recorded
links.firstVisitTooltip: This visitor's first click on this link
links.returningVisitorTooltip: This visitor has clicked this link {{count}} times total
links.signalsLabel: Security signals — tap one to see what it means
links.approximateLocationNote: Approximate location computed from the IP address, not an exact address

botConfidenceTooltip.LIKELY_HUMAN: This visit was detected as coming from a real human.
botConfidenceTooltip.POSSIBLE_BOT: Browser info is missing or suspicious — detected as possibly an automated tool.
botConfidenceTooltip.LIKELY_BOT: This visit was detected as coming from a known bot/crawler.
botConfidenceTooltip.UNKNOWN: Couldn't detect whether this is a human or a bot.

vpn.YES: This visitor was detected connecting through a VPN.
vpn.UNKNOWN: This provider can't detect VPN usage.

proxy.YES: This visitor was detected connecting through a proxy/VPN/Tor exit address.
proxy.UNKNOWN: This provider can't detect proxy usage.

tor.YES: This visitor was detected connecting through the Tor network.
tor.UNKNOWN: This provider can't detect Tor usage.

hosting.YES: This IP was detected as a datacenter/hosting address — likely not a real home/office connection.
hosting.NO: Detected as a regular connection, not a datacenter IP.
hosting.UNKNOWN: This provider can't detect hosting IPs.

createLink.destinationUrlHint: Whoever clicks the short link ends up here.
createLink.campaignHint: Pick a project and this link joins its stats, and the "Project/effort name" field below gets auto-filled. If the project gets paused or archived, this link stops working too.
createLink.customAliasHint: Leave blank and a random code is generated (e.g. /aB3xY2). Write your own if you want something memorable (e.g. /summer-sale).
createLink.descriptionHint: A reminder of what this link is for — only you see this, visitors never do.
createLink.requireConsentHint: When on, clickers see a consent screen first; details like location and device are only recorded if they agree. When off, those details are recorded directly.
createLink.passwordHint: Set a password and clickers must enter it before being sent to the destination.
createLink.utmIntro: Fill these in if you want to tell apart who clicked from where on the Analytics page. None of them are required.
createLink.utmSourceHint: Where did you share this link? E.g. "instagram", "google", "newsletter".
createLink.utmCampaignHint: The name you gave this effort. E.g. "client-a-launch-2026". Auto-suggested from the project you picked above — edit freely.
createLink.utmTermHint: Usually used in paid ads to note which search keyword was targeted.
createLink.utmContentHint: Use this to tell apart multiple images/copy variants in the same effort. E.g. "blue-button".
createLink.urlInvalid: Enter a valid URL, including https://

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your profile, security, and sessions.

profile.title: Profile
profile.avatarHint: PNG, JPEG or WEBP, up to 2MB

security.twoFactorBody: Require a code from an authenticator app in addition to your password when signing in.
security.setupIntro: Two-factor authentication adds a second step to sign-in using an authenticator app.
security.confirmIntro: Scan this into your authenticator app, or enter the secret manually, then confirm with a generated code.
security.backupCodesIntro: Save these backup codes somewhere safe. Each can be used once if you lose access to your authenticator.
security.disableIntro: Confirm your password and a current code to disable 2FA.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.body: Deleting your account permanently removes your projects, links, and visit history. This cannot be undone.
danger.confirmBody: Enter your password to confirm. This action is irreversible.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Filter by link or project, dig into visitor trends and country/device/browser breakdowns, export as a report.
analytics.createLinkHint: Create a link to start seeing analytics here.

qr.title: QR Codes
qr.subtitle: Generate a customizable QR code for any of your links, or any URL — great for print materials like posters and business cards.
qr.noneCustomUrl: None — use a custom URL instead
qr.emptyPreviewDescription: Pick a link or enter a URL to generate a QR code.

urlTools.title: URL Tools
urlTools.subtitle: Encode/decode URLs, build UTM-tagged links, and trace step-by-step where an address actually redirects to.

security.title: Security Center
security.subtitle: Analyze a domain's SSL certificate, DNS records, WHOIS registration, security headers, and reputation.
security.scanningHint: Running DNS, WHOIS, SSL, and header checks…
security.noScansDescription: Run your first domain scan above.

apiKeys.title: API
apiKeys.subtitle: Manage the API keys you'd use to pull your link/visit data into your own systems automatically — e.g. a client-facing dashboard.
apiKeys.emptyDescription: Create one to authenticate requests without a session cookie.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.revealBody: Copy this now — for your security, you won't be able to see it again.
apiKeys.revokeConfirmBody: "{{name}}" will stop authenticating immediately. This can't be undone.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.subtitle: Get an automatic, signed (HMAC) notification sent to your own server whenever there's a new click, link, or security alert — no need to watch the dashboard.
webhooks.secretRevealBody: Use this to verify the X-Webhook-Signature header (HMAC-SHA256). Copy it now.
webhooks.emptyDescription: Add an endpoint to start receiving events.
webhooks.noDeliveriesDescription: Trigger an event or use the test button.
webhooks.deleteConfirmBody: Delivery history will be permanently deleted. This can't be undone.

devices.title: Devices
devices.subtitle: View and control your own Android phone's screen from the browser. Pairing requires confirming a code on the physical device — no device is ever added silently.
devices.pairInstructions: Scan this QR code or enter the code in the FurOfTheWeak companion app on your phone.
devices.emptyDescription: Pair a device to view and control its screen from here.
devices.notEnabledDescription: Ask the server administrator to set ENABLE_DEVICE_CONTROL=true to use this module.
devices.revokeConfirmBody: This immediately ends any active session and the device will need to be paired again to reconnect.
devices.waitingForDevice: Waiting for the device to connect…
devices.controlHint: Click and drag on the screen to send touch input. This is a live, unrecorded peer-to-peer connection.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.prefLinkFirstVisit: A link gets its first visit
notifications.prefSecurityWarning: A security scan finds a low score
